{{Infobox Fusion
|quote=<translate><!--T:1--> A Potara-style fusion anyone can afford.</translate>
|Method=<translate><!--T:2--> Eating a matching pair of beetles</translate>
|Requirements=<translate><!--T:3--> Both players eat beetles with the same pair ID within 30 seconds and 20 blocks of each other</translate>
|Duration=<translate><!--T:4--> The full server duration (15 minutes by default)</translate>
|Item=<translate><!--T:5--> Pair of Medi-Bugs (Beetle)</translate>
|Result=<translate><!--T:6--> Bonus STR, SKP and PWR, ×1.25 to ×2.0</translate>
|Ending=<translate><!--T:7--> The beetles are consumed</translate>
}}
<translate>
<!--T:8-->
The '''Medi-Bug Beetles''' are a Potara-style fusion from the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Demon Realm]] that anyone can afford, with no dragon needed. Two players who eat a matching pair of beetles fuse, whatever their races.
</translate>

<translate>
== Getting the beetles == <!--T:9-->

<!--T:10-->
* Buy a '''Pair of Medi-Bugs (Beetle)''' for 16 emeralds from the bug traders among the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm Villager|Demon Realm Villagers]]. Their trades restock once per in-game day.
* Or get one from Bulma's repeatable '''Medi-Bug Market''' sidequest, unlocked during the [[Special:MyLanguage/Daima Saga|Daima Saga]]: bring her emeralds and gold ingots and she orders a batch of Medi-Bugs, a Beetle pair included, once an hour.
* '''Right-click''' the pair to split it into two identical '''Medi-Bug (Beetle)''' items sharing the same pair ID. Give one to your partner.
</translate>

<translate>
== Fusing == <!--T:11-->

<!--T:12-->
# Each player '''eats''' their beetle. You must both eat beetles '''with the same pair ID''' within '''30 seconds''' of each other and be within '''20 blocks'''. The first player sees "Waiting for your partner to eat the other beetle…".
# The two players are pulled together into the Potara pose and fuse. '''The player who ate first is the leader''' and controls the fused body.
# If your partner doesn't eat theirs in time, your beetle wears off.
</translate>

<translate>
== Result == <!--T:13-->

<!--T:14-->
* Bonus stats scale from '''×1.25 to ×2.0''' (STR, SKP and PWR), like the [[Special:MyLanguage/Fusion Dance|Fusion Dance]].
* Like the [[Special:MyLanguage/Potara Earrings|Potara Earrings]], '''any races''' can fuse, there is no stat-gap limit, and upgraded Androids can fuse too.
* The fusion lasts the full server duration. When its timer runs out, the leader goes on Fusion cooldown, which only blocks the Fusion Dance.

<!--T:15-->
What you can and can't do while fused is described on the [[Special:MyLanguage/Fusions|Fusions]] page.
</translate>

<translate>
== Other Medi-Bugs == <!--T:16-->

<!--T:17-->
The same traders sell other Medi-Bugs that don't fuse: the '''Ant''' (restores 85% of your health, ki and stamina), the '''Rhino''' (30% less damage for 45 seconds) and the '''Worm''' (50% more form mastery for 5 minutes). See [[Special:MyLanguage/Items|Items]].
</translate>
